title: Netflix Builds Quasar to Measure the Blast Radius of Library API Changes
blurb: Netflix developed Quasar, an internal tool that combines semantic code indexing and API comparisons to identify downstream consumers affected by library changes.

title: Grafana Begins Its Biggest UI Refresh Since Version 7
blurb: Grafana Labs has introduced the first phase of its biggest visual refresh since Grafana 7, bringing updated themes, more consistent interface components, and improved visual hierarchy to its observability platform. By Craig Risi

title: Presentation: From Fan-Out to Fast: Sub-100ms API Design in Distributed Systems
blurb: Saranya Vedagiri explains how to design resilient, low-latency distributed APIs under 100ms.

title: Article: Engineering Reliable Telematics from Smartphone Sensors
blurb: Smartphones make telematics more accessible by combining location, motion sensors, computing power, and connectivity in a single device.

title: Mozilla Partners with Mistral to Bring Open-Weight AI Models to Firefox Smart Window
blurb: Mozilla has partnered with Mistral AI to offer Mistral Small 4, an open-weight model, in Firefox's Smart Window AI assistant, now in beta. It is recommended for users in France, the US and Canada.

title: QCon San Francisco 2026: How to Kill the Code Review
blurb: Ankit Jain of Aviator told QCon San Francisco 2026 that line-by-line code review is already fading, since most review comments concern knowledge sharing rather than defects and over 75% of PRs merge without human review.

title: Building a Production-Ready Culture and Skills through SRE-Based Training
blurb: Training can act as a confidence engine, turning repeated behaviors into habits and culture.

title: Presentation: Finetuning Your Embedding Model for Better Search: Learning from Agentic Search at Dell
blurb: Rachel Shalom explains how Dell solved enterprise RAG retrieval failures on internal terminology by fine-tuning open-source embedding models.

title: .NET MAUI 11 Makes CoreCLR the Default Runtime and Adds Incremental XAML Hot Reload
blurb: Microsoft released .NET 11 with a .NET MAUI update focused on product quality. CoreCLR is now the default runtime on all platforms, and XAML gets incremental hot reload, implicit namespaces and faster resource dictionaries.

title: Mock Service Worker Releases v3.0 with ESM-Only Build, Socket-Based Interception and GraphQL Subs
blurb: Mock Service Worker 3.0 is now ESM-only, requires Node.js 22 or later, and cuts package size from 416KB to 234KB. It adds GraphQL subscription support, protocol-specific entrypoints, and an experimental defineNetwork API.

title: Recap of Microsoft Ignite 2026: Copilot as the Work OS and Agent Governance
blurb: At Ignite 2026, Microsoft positioned Copilot as the operating system for work and extended agent identity, governance, and cost controls across Azure, Foundry, Entra, and Defender.

title: DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 Aims to Make Robots Safer, More Dexterous, and Faster Learners
blurb: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, a vision-language-action (VLA) model designed to improve robots' dexterity, reliability, and learning speed, while enabling safer operation in unstructured real-world environments.

title: GitHub Ditches CSS-in-JS for CSS Modules, Reports 55% Faster SSR after Three-Year Migration
blurb: GitHub migrated github.com from styled-components to CSS Modules over three years, reporting a 55% cut in server-side rendering time and 25% faster component initialisation.

title: DoorDash Scales Dispatch 10x While Maintaining 99.99% Peak Availability
blurb: DoorDash has redesigned its real-time dispatch platform, replacing a monolithic optimization engine with a distributed architecture that separates coordination from computation.

title: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB 3 now supports heterogeneous clusters
blurb: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB 3 now supports heterogeneous clusters, which let you assign a different instance size to each node role in an InfluxDB 3 Enterprise cluster. You can size the writer, reader, and compactor roles independently.

title: Amazon CloudWatch announces basic OpenTelemetry enrichment at no additional cost
blurb: Amazon CloudWatch now offers basic OpenTelemetry enrichment for AWS service metrics at no additional cost. Basic enrichment turns the metrics that AWS services publish to CloudWatch into OpenTelemetry data points you can query with PromQL.

title: Amazon Neptune introduces Neptune Graph Sessions, smaller graphs designed for agents that scale to zero and resume automatically
blurb: Amazon Neptune now supports Neptune Graph Sessions, a compute mode designed for agents that scales memory and CPU automatically and scales to zero when idle.

title: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL supports minor versions 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25
blurb: Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) for PostgreSQL now supports the latest minor versions 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25.

title: AWS Lambda now supports orchestrating MicroVMs with Lambda durable functions
blurb: Today, AWS announces a developer preview of a new extension for orchestrating Lambda MicroVMs with Lambda durable functions . The extension adds durable operations for running work on MicroVMs and managing their lifecycle.

title: Amazon CloudWatch Omni now integrates with PagerDuty
blurb: Amazon CloudWatch Omni alerts can now automatically create PagerDuty incidents, so notifications flow directly into your existing incident management workflows.

title: Amazon EC2 M8g instances are now available in Israel (Tel Aviv)
blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) M8g instances are available in the Israel (Tel Aviv) region.

title: Amazon EC2 M9gd instances are now available in Asia Pacific (Seoul)
blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) M9gd instances are available in the Asia Pacific (Seoul) region.

title: Amazon OpenSearch Service optimised engine now publishes data to Amazon S3 Tables
blurb: The optimized engine for observability in Amazon OpenSearch Service now lets customers who send observability data directly to OpenSearch publish that data to Amazon S3 Tables.

title: Amazon EC2 C9gd instances now available in additional regions
blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) C9gd instances are available in the Europe (Ireland, Spain) regions.

title: Amazon EC2 C9g instances are now available in additional regions
blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) C9g instances are available in the Asia Pacific (Sydney), Europe (Ireland, Spain), and South America (São Paulo) regions.

title: Amazon EC2 M9g instances now available in additional regions
blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) M9g instances, powered by AWS Graviton5 processors, are available in US West (N. California), Canada (Central), South America (São Paulo), and Asia Pacific (Seoul) regions.

title: Elastic Load Balancing for Envoy is now generally available
blurb: Today, AWS announces the general availability of ELB for Envoy, a new load balancer type in Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) that runs open-source Envoy proxies.

title: Amazon Transcribe Turbo: more accurate transcripts and natural turn-taking for voice agents, now in public preview
blurb: Amazon Transcribe Turbo, our next-generation speech-to-text model, is now in public preview in US East (Ohio) for batch and streaming.

title: AWS IoT Core now uses dedicated IPv6 address ranges for the HTTP rule action
blurb: AWS IoT Core can now send traffic to HTTPS endpoints within a dedicated, published IPv6 address range.

title: AWS IoT Core quotas and usage are now visible in AWS Service Quotas console
blurb: AWS IoT Core now publishes its most used service quotas and your current usage against the quotas in AWS Service Quotas console , improving observability and monitoring of API limits and quotas.

title: AWS Device Farm now supports Android emulators and iOS simulators
blurb: AWS Device Farm , a service for testing mobile and web apps, now supports Android emulators and iOS simulators alongside real devices for automated and manual testing, enabling faster testing at scale early in your development pipeline.

title: AWS IAM extends trusted identity propagation to IAM federation and IAM Roles Anywhere, and simplifies it in IAM Identity Center
blurb: Trusted identity propagation (TIP) carries the identity of a human user or workload with requests to supported AWS Services.

title: Amazon Bedrock adds bedrock-runtime endpoint support for OpenAI Daybreak Red in AWS GovCloud (US)
blurb: Eligible customers can now access OpenAI’s specialized cybersecurity models Daybreak Red: GPT-5.6 Cyber through the bedrock-runtime endpoint on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US).

title: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless is now available in the Africa (Cape Town) Region
blurb: Starting today, the next generation of Amazon OpenSearch Serverless is available in the AWS Africa (Cape Town) Region.

title: AWS CloudFormation makes resource coverage comprehensive with 206 new types
blurb: AWS CloudFormation now supports 206 additional resource types across 88 services, including Amazon SageMaker Hub, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore PolicyEngine, and Amazon EC2 Snapshot.

title: Amazon Connect Customer dashboards now support grouping historical metrics by time interval
blurb: Amazon Connect Customer analytics dashboards now support grouping historical metrics by time interval on trailing widgets, giving contact center managers granular control over how performance data is visualized over time.

title: Amazon OpenSearch Service optimized engine supports high-cardinality query and DSL
blurb: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports distributed joins, high-cardinality aggregations, and OpenSearch query DSL on the new engine. Observability data often spans logs, traces, and agent traces.

title: Amazon RDS for SQL Server now supports up to 500 databases per instance
blurb: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for SQL Server now supports up to 500 databases per DB instance, up from the previous limit of 100.

title: Amazon EC2 X8i instances are now available in the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region
blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) X8i instances are available in the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region. These instances are powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors available only on AWS.

title: AWS Sign-In introduces configurable Sign-in duration of up to 90 days
blurb: AWS Sign-In now enables developers and AI agents to stay authenticated for up to 90 days without frequent sign-ins or consent prompts.

title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports managed observability and user management extensions for Slurm clusters
blurb: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports managed cluster extensions for Slurm clusters. You can install, configure, update, and remove managed features through the SageMaker AI console or API.

title: Amazon API Gateway announces API Portal
blurb: Today, Amazon API Gateway announces API Portal , a new feature that discovers, governs, and documents the APIs and AI endpoints behind Amazon API Gateway, Application Load Balancer, and Amazon CloudFront across your AWS organization.

title: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports OpenSearch version 3.9
blurb: You can now run OpenSearch version 3.9 on Amazon OpenSearch Service. OpenSearch 3.9 helps you reduce vector memory and storage, evaluate search quality with more large language model (LLM) providers, build more responsive AI agents, and…

title: AWS WAF introduces simplified pricing
blurb: AWS WAF now offers simplified pricing that follows what you protect instead of how you configure it.

title: AWS WAF announces automated discovery and protection for LLM, MCP, and A2A endpoints using Amazon Bedrock Guardrails
blurb: Automated AI endpoint discovery and protection are now generally available, enabling you to discover language model (LLM), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Agent2Agent (A2A) endpoints behind Amazon API Gateway, Application Load Balancers,…

title: Amazon Connect Customer launches the ability to force logout agents directly from the analytics dashboard
blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now allows supervisors to force logout agents directly from the real-time analytics dashboard, eliminating the need to manually contact agents to end their sessions.

title: Amazon Connect Customer now lets you test AI model version upgrades for automated evaluations
blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now enables managers to test new AI model versions for automated evaluations before switching, so evaluation scores remain consistent through model upgrades.

title: Amazon Connect Customer expands automated performance evaluations to 45 new languages
blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now uses generative AI to automate evaluations of human and AI agent performance in 45 additional languages, such as Arabic, Dutch, Indonesian, and Polish.

title: Amazon CloudFront is now available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud
blurb: Amazon CloudFront is now available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud. Organizations with strict EU sovereignty requirements can now deliver websites, applications, and APIs with the performance, security, and scale of CloudFront, all…

title: AWS Partner Central expands analytics access with Partner Central Agents and Data Subscriptions
blurb: AWS Partners and AWS Marketplace sellers now have two new ways to access their analytics data in AWS Partner Central.

title: AgentCore runtime instances are now generally available in the AWS GovCloud (US-West) Region
blurb: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime instances are now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-West) Region.

title: Amazon CloudFront Announces HTTP/2 Support for Connections to Origins
blurb: Amazon CloudFront now supports HTTP/2 connections to custom origins and VPC origins. HTTP/2 lets CloudFront send many requests over fewer connections to your origin.

title: AWS Quick adds identity-aware access via 3LO for Snowflake and Databricks structured data sources
blurb: AWS Quick now supports three-legged OAuth (3LO) with end-user permissions for Snowflake and Databricks.

title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now detects and recovers hung training jobs on Slurm clusters
blurb: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports hung job detection for Slurm-orchestrated clusters, which finds training jobs that have stopped making progress and returns them to the job queue.

title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod extends AMI auto-patching to Slurm and inference on EKS
blurb: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now automatically patches AMIs on Slurm clusters and introduces a new AMI patching strategy for Amazon EKS clusters that deploy inference workloads.

title: RDS PostgreSQL now supports PostgreSQL 19.0 in the Amazon RDS Database Preview Environment
blurb: Starting today, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 19.0 is available in the Amazon RDS Database Preview Environment , allowing you to evaluate PostgreSQL 19.0 on Amazon RDS PostgreSQL.

title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now detects Kubernetes issues affecting training
blurb: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now detects Kubernetes issues that disrupt training, such as crash-looping device plugins or missing DaemonSets, on clusters orchestrated by Amazon EKS.

title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod deep health check now validates training correctness
blurb: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod clusters orchestrated by Amazon EKS now support MultiNodeTrainingValidation, a deep health check that validates nodes train correctly before your jobs run.

title: AWS Quick brings AI-ready capabilities to your existing datasets
blurb: Today, AWS Quick makes your legacy datasets AI ready through the new technology stack used by its improved visual data preparation experience. This stack powers Dataset Semantics, topics and semantic models, and Dataset Evaluation.

title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports NCCL profiling for training jobs
blurb: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports NVIDIA Collective Communications Library (NCCL) profiling with the HyperPod NCCL Profiler, giving you visibility into communication performance across the nodes and GPUs in a distributed training job.

title: AWS Global Accelerator now preserves client IPs for NLBs with TLS listeners
blurb: AWS Global Accelerator now preserves the client IP address for traffic sent to Network Load Balancer (NLB) endpoints with TLS listeners. You can terminate TLS at your NLB and still see the original client IP address in your application.

title: Announcing metal size for Amazon EC2 G7 instances
blurb: Today, AWS announces the general availability of the metal size for Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) G7 instances, accelerated by NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs.

title: Amazon Aurora serverless for MySQL now supports up to 384 ACUs
blurb: Amazon Aurora serverless now supports database capacity of up to 384 Aurora Capacity Units (ACUs) for Aurora MySQL-Compatible Edition, a 50% increase from the previous maximum of 256 ACUs.

title: Amazon SageMaker Studio now supports training job submission and model deployment for SageMaker HyperPod clusters
blurb: Amazon SageMaker Studio now provides a native developer experience for Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, enabling data scientists to submit distributed training jobs, deploy models, and monitor workloads through a visual interface on HyperPod…

title: Amazon Connect Customer AI agents now fill in step-by-step guides
blurb: AI agents in Amazon Connect Customer can now populate fields of a step-by-step guide for contact center agents during live customer interactions.

title: Amazon Inspector expands runtime reachability analysis for ECR and EC2 findings
blurb: Amazon Inspector has expanded its vulnerability management capabilities with runtime reachability analysis for findings originating from Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2)…

title: AWS CodeDeploy now supports suspending Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling processes
blurb: AWS CodeDeploy can now suspend Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling processes during EC2 in-place deployments to Auto Scaling groups.

title: AWS WAF announces automated discovery and protection for API endpoints
blurb: Automated API discovery and protection are now generally available, enabling you to discover every API behind Amazon API Gateway, Application Load Balancers, and Amazon CloudFront across your AWS Organization and protect them using AWS…

title: AWS Device Farm launches Device Connect for local access to remote Android devices
blurb: AWS Device Farm , a service for testing mobile and web apps, now offers Device Connect.

title: Amazon SageMaker AI now supports viewing capacity reservations
blurb: Amazon SageMaker AI now lets you view SageMaker Capacity Reservations in the SageMaker console, AWS CLI, and AWS SDKs.

title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod launches a redesigned console experience for creating Amazon EKS-orchestrated clusters
blurb: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now offers a redesigned AWS Management Console experience for creating clusters orchestrated by Amazon EKS.

title: AWS DevOps Agent adds Access Profiles and AWS Organizations
blurb: AWS DevOps Agent now gives you more ways to govern and control your AWS DevOps Agent instances. With the new Access Profiles feature you can link IAM IDC users in your Agent Spaces to specific permission sets.

title: AWS Systems Manager Automation now automates operational tasks in Azure and Google Cloud
blurb: AWS Systems Manager Automation now lets you create custom workflows (runbooks) that can automate operational tasks across Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and AWS resources.

title: Amazon EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML now supports search across multiple instance types and AWS Regions
blurb: Amazon EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML now lets customers search across multiple instance types and AWS Regions in a single search, making it easier to find and reserve the capacity their ML workloads need.

title: AWS Parallel Computing Service now supports Split Cost Allocation Data
blurb: Starting today, customers can receive granular cost visibility for AWS Parallel Computing Service (AWS PCS) in the AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR), enabling you to analyze, optimize, and chargeback costs for your Slurm jobs.

title: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP adds AWS CloudFormation and Console support for snapshots, clones, and data replication
blurb: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP now lets you snapshot, clone, and replicate your data directly from the Amazon FSx Console and AWS CloudFormation.

title: You can now copy data server-side between Amazon S3 buckets and Amazon FSx file systems with S3 Access Points
blurb: You can now use Amazon S3 Access Points to copy or move data server-side between Amazon S3 general purpose buckets and Amazon FSx file systems within the same AWS Region, making it faster, lower-cost, and easier to move your data between…

title: AWS Certificate Manager now supports Amazon N2 certificates for mTLS
blurb: AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) now issues Amazon N2 certificates for mutual TLS (mTLS) and other authentication outside web browsers.

title: Amazon CloudWatch Query Studio now supports saved queries
blurb: Amazon CloudWatch Query Studio now lets you save your PromQL and SQL metrics queries and reuse them. You no longer need to rewrite or search for queries you run often, such as a latency query you check during every incident.

title: AWS Quick now supports plugins to bundle agents, skills, connectors and flows
blurb: AWS Quick now supports plugins, agents, skills, connectors, and flows built for a specific task, role, or use case.

title: Amazon CloudWatch Omni now supports Microsoft Azure platform logs, metrics and traces
blurb: Amazon CloudWatch Omni now supports collecting Azure resource logs, Azure Monitor platform metrics, virtual network (VNet) flow logs, and traces from Application Insights.

title: AWS Quick launches a new web experience with updated browser extension and Microsoft 365 add-ins
blurb: The AWS Quick web app now brings the Quick desktop experience to your browser. Create, share, and use the same agents and skills as on desktop, with the same connectors.

title: Web Search on Amazon Bedrock expands language support and country-aware search
blurb: Web Search on Amazon Bedrock, the tool that grounds AI agents and applications in cited, current web information, now supports five new languages, plus non-US English, on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Amazon Bedrock: Spanish, French,…

title: Build more capable automations through chat with Flows in AWS Quick
blurb: Flows in AWS Quick now lets users build, run, and refine automations for themselves and their teams, all through conversation. Users describe a process in chat, and Quick builds the flow, with no coding needed.

title: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports Primary Endpoint
blurb: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for Oracle now provides a Primary Endpoint, a DNS name that always resolves to the current primary DB instance in a replica configuration.

title: AWS Lambda now publishes Event Function state change events to Amazon EventBridge
blurb: AWS Lambda now publishes Event Function state change events to Amazon EventBridge .

title: AWS Network Firewall introduces automated Internet firewall (Preview)
blurb: AWS Network Firewall announces the public preview of automated internet firewall (Preview), a new centralized control that allows you to configure Network Firewall, with native network address translation (NAT) capability, on the internet…

title: AWS Quick now supports Japanese, German, Vietnamese, and Chinese
blurb: Today, AWS announces that AWS Quick, the AI workspace for business users, now supports Japanese, German, Vietnamese, and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional).

title: AWS Compute Optimizer automation rules now support organizational units
blurb: AWS Compute Optimizer automation rules can now target the organizational units (OUs) you manage with AWS Organizations, making it easier for large organizations to scale optimization across their accounts.

title: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports Replica First Patching for reduced downtime
blurb: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for Oracle now supports Replica First Patching, which reduces downtime during minor version upgrades. Replica First Patching is available for Enterprise Edition DB instances.

title: Amazon Cognito extends multi-Region replication to additional AWS Regions
blurb: Amazon Cognito multi-Region replication (MRR) now supports additional AWS Regions, extending the resilience benefits of MRR to more workloads.

title: Amazon Neptune Serverless now delivers up to 30% better performance and smarter scaling
blurb: Amazon Neptune Serverless now delivers up to 30% better performance at the same price per Neptune Capacity Unit, running on AWS Graviton4 processors.

title: Amazon CloudWatch extends the PromQL query window to 30 days
blurb: Amazon CloudWatch now supports a 30-day query window for PromQL queries against OpenTelemetry metrics, up from 7 days.

title: AWS DevOps Agent achieves FedRAMP Class D Certification in AWS GovCloud (US-West)
blurb: AWS DevOps Agent is now certified at the Federal Risk and Authorization Management (FedRAMP) Class D level in AWS GovCloud (US).

title: Demand Center now available in AWS Partner Central
blurb: AWS Partners can now plan, launch, fund, and measure demand generation campaigns in one AI-powered experience.

title: Account Mapping and Planning now available in AWS Partner Central
blurb: AWS Partners can now map their target accounts against AWS records and find where to collaborate with AWS on joint go-to-market before an opportunity exists.

title: Lead groups and channel recommendations now available in AWS Partner Central
blurb: AWS Partners can now organize enriched leads and plan outreach with lead groups and channel recommendations in AWS Partner Central.

title: Amazon CloudWatch EKS Container Insights now offers built-in monitoring for open source Kubernetes tools
blurb: Today, Amazon CloudWatch announces built-in monitoring for open source tools running on your Amazon EKS clusters, including Karpenter, KEDA, vLLM, KServe, SGLang, Ray and Knative Serving.

title: AWS Quick now supports group assignments for custom permissions and limit profiles
blurb: AWS Quick now supports assignments for custom permissions and limit profiles to groups from your enterprise identity provider (IdP).

title: AWS Quick introduces enterprise guardrails (preview)
blurb: AWS Quick now includes enterprise guardrails, giving administrators configurable content safety and sensitive-information controls for user prompts.

title: AWS announces Data Hub in AWS Billing and Cost Management (preview)
blurb: Today, AWS announces the preview of Data Hub in AWS Billing and Cost Management, a managed data layer that enables AWS FinOps Agent to query cost and usage data with SQL.

title: Amazon CloudWatch Observability EKS add-on now supports custom OpenTelemetry and Prometheus telemetry
blurb: Today, Amazon CloudWatch announces support for your own application telemetry in the CloudWatch Observability EKS add-on.

title: Amazon DynamoDB vector search now supports new inline filter operators
blurb: Amazon DynamoDB vector search inline filters now support range comparisons, value lists, and logical operators in addition to the equality operator, so you can narrow a vector search to exactly the items you want.

title: Amazon Transcribe announces a synchronous transcription API
blurb: Amazon Transcribe now offers a synchronous transcription API, TranscribeAudio . Send a complete audio file in a single request and get the full transcript back in the same response.

title: AWS Private CA now supports X.509 IAM condition keys
blurb: AWS Private Certificate Authority (AWS Private CA) now supports IAM condition keys that describe the certificate being issued.

title: Amazon CloudWatch Observability EKS add-on now supports telemetry filtering
blurb: Today, Amazon CloudWatch announces telemetry filtering for the CloudWatch Observability EKS add-on, so you can stop paying to ingest telemetry you don't use.

title: Amazon SageMaker JumpStart now offers a model leaderboard to compare models on quality, speed, and cost
blurb: Amazon SageMaker JumpStart now offers a model leaderboard in Amazon SageMaker Studio.

title: AWS Partner Central Agents now help partners create and manage Partner Central and Marketplace support cases
blurb: AWS Partner Central Agents now help AWS Partners create and manage AWS Partner Central and AWS Marketplace support cases in one place.

title: Spend limits in the new AWS experience now support SMS alerts
blurb: Builders using the new AWS experience on the Paid plan can now receive spend limit alerts by text message (SMS), alongside existing email notifications. A spend limit sets the maximum monthly cost for a project.

title: Amazon S3 Vectors raises the filterable metadata limit to 40 KB per vector
blurb: Amazon S3 Vectors now supports up to 40 KB of filterable metadata per vector, up from 2 KB.

title: AWS Lambda now provides cost optimization recommendations for Event Functions
blurb: AWS Lambda now provides cost optimization recommendations for Event Functions in AWS Trusted Advisor .

title: AWS Lambda now supports a batch size of up to 10,000 messages for Amazon SQS FIFO queues
blurb: AWS Lambda now supports a batch size of up to 10,000 messages for Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue event source mappings (ESMs) in provisioned mode , up from 10 messages previously.

title: AWS Glue Data Catalog introduces data quality monitoring for catalogs and databases
blurb: AWS Glue Data Catalog introduces data quality monitoring for catalogs and databases, powered by AWS Glue Data Quality, which profiles and evaluates your tables at catalog scale from a single configuration.

title: AWS Pricing Calculator now estimates workload costs through a new API
blurb: AWS Pricing Calculator now offers GetUsageLinesEstimatedCost, a new API that returns the estimated cost of a planned workload in a single API call.
